Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

MMSpower 1.0.0

First release.

  • Design functions for four common questions in malaria molecular surveillance: design_precision() (estimating a prevalence), design_threshold() (testing against a threshold), design_detection() (detecting a rare variant) and design_difference() (comparing two groups). Each returns the sample size needed for a target, or, given a full design, the margin of error, power or detection probability that design achieves.
  • Matching analysis functions: estimate_prevalence(), test_threshold() and test_difference().
  • estimate_cost() costs a design by stage (screened, collected, sequenced) plus a per-site cost, and checks it against a budget.
  • All functions allow for an imperfect diagnostic test and for clustered sampling across sites, through the intra-cluster correlation (ICC).

Developed by Sequoia Leuba, Robert Verity.

Site built with pkgdown 2.2.1.
